name: kpred-picks
description: KnodeGames Picks: one generic contract that keeps free and staked picks, locked by the chain. Holds no tokens.

scripts.build: koinos-sdk-as-cli build-all release 0 picks.proto --generate_authorize && node scripts/make-abi.cjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node node_modules/@as-pect/cli/bin/asp.js --config as-pect.config.js
